_comment: iOS 2.2.1 (5H11a) overlay on rootfs/recipe.json. Applied by scripts/versions.py into build/fw-2.2.1/recipe.json; the 4.2.1 recipe is never changed. 2.x has no dyld shared cache (frameworks are individual dylibs) and no MBXGLEngine/Substrate, so all cache patches, interposers, Cydia and TLSFix are left out. /System/Library/Caches/com.apple.dyld does not exist on this rootfs, so the 4.2.1 'enable-dylibs-to-override-cache' marker is not written either.
_todo: 2.x needs separate liblockdownd.dylib / bool override patches (no shared cache) and a 2.x SDK stub-symbol list. Darwin 9 lacks IOSurface, CoreMotion and Celestial's 4.x API: our 4.2.1 userland binaries cannot simply be copied here.
